title: palicourea botryocephala
intro:
Palicourea botryocephala, commonly known as the "red ironbark" or "red ironwood," is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, native to the tropical forests of Central and South America.

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Palicourea botryocephala include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to treat infections, wounds, and diseases such as cancer and diabetes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimalarial, antiviral, and anti-parasitic effects.
